Name: Walking speed
Description: Normal ground movement below the analog run threshold uses this value. Special actions can use other rules.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once to the current Sora actor, including supported Drive forms. No automatic restore on disconnect. Scripts or actor replacement may overwrite it. Applying a profile sends the value once; re-enter the scene or transform to obtain a newly initialized actor.

Evidence.Finding: The shared Sora input callback selects Actor+296 below an input magnitude of 0.8.
Evidence.Level: Full native IDA assembly and synthetic memory guards. Live movement validation is pending. The edit bounds are trainer policy, not native limits.
